# Exercise 1 — Your First Run {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #FF7A5C)"}

Watch it work across files

## Give It a Real (Sandboxed) Task {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Build
Point Cowork at the **sandbox folder**, then give it one end-to-end task — e.g.
*"Read these three student feedback files and produce one summary note."*
:::

. . .

::: {.incremental}
- Watch it **open files**, not just chat
- Watch it **run steps** in order
- It **proposes** the result — you stay in the loop and approve
:::

# Exercise 2 — Package a Skill {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Build it once, run it forever

## Make One Skill {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Build
1. Pick one **recurring** task from your week (feedback notes, weekly digest, reading
   summary).
2. Save it as a **Skill** — give it a **name**, a **trigger** phrase, and the **steps**.
3. **Invoke the trigger twice** on two different inputs to prove it generalizes.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
This one repeats every week — note the **recurring** time saved.
:::

## Stretch — Schedule It (Notify-Me) {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-note}
## Optional
Turn your Skill into a standing appointment with **`/schedule`** — *"Every Sunday 5pm,
draft my week-ahead summary."* Keep it in **draft / notify-me** mode.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #FF7A5C; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Guardrails first — promote to act-on-its-own only after it earns your trust.
:::
